build_value_iteration_network: build a Value Iteration Network with convolutions and max pooling across action and value channels
build_map_from_images: build a top-view map from images using a ResNet encoder, FC layers, and deconvolution
build_fusion_network: build a ResNet-based fusion network to combine map and reward map information with bottleneck blocks
build_upsampling_network: build an upsampling network with residual connections and batch normalization for deconvolution
combine_rotated_predictions: combine rotated predictions across time steps by accumulating weighted logits and confidence probabilities
